title: 第7章 赤云子道心不稳第8章 报复
content_zh:
第7章赤云子道心不稳
要到干活的时间了，盘膝而坐的林浩停止修炼从小木床上起来。
“先定个小目标，修炼到炼气九重。”
他充满了斗志。
只要用五行长生功，修炼到炼气九重，他便拥有比同境界修士多一半的寿命，也就是一百八十岁。
“老大，你突破到炼气一重了吗？”
小胖子王富与林浩聊天，听林浩提起过，可能在最近几日就能突破。
所以一大早，他便关心的问道。
“嗯，已经突破了。”
林浩笑了笑回道。
“老大，不愧是被柳师姐招进来的天才弟子，果然厉害。”
王富胖脸上，露出羡慕之色。
“以后别再提我是天才弟子的事情了，要低调。”
林浩听到小胖子说起‘柳师姐’，脸上露出不自然之色。
他真实灵根只是一品五行灵根，不知道小胖子王富知道真相后，会是什么样的表情。
还会心甘情愿，叫自己老大吗？
两人聊着天，并肩出了屋子，前往灵矿山。
领了挖矿的工具，林浩和小胖子，进入了矿洞之中。
“锵锵！
钉钉！”

大量杂役弟子在挖矿，一声声石头的凿击敲打声，不停响起。
“力气变大了！”
林浩挥动手中的十字镐，发现突破到炼气一重，力气比以往大了至少三倍。
未突破前，吃了半月灵粥的他，也只拥有接近两百斤的力量，而现在至少有六百斤。
力量大增的林浩，挖矿速度暴涨。
只是两个时辰，就挖出了可以换一顿饭的灵铁。
这还是他故意藏拙的情况下，如果调用体内灵力全力挖矿。
估计只需一个时辰出头，他就能挖出可以换一顿饭的灵铁。
“老大，你这也太强了！”
不远处小胖子王富满脸崇拜，道：“那严衡修为都快接近炼气二重了，挖矿速度也比不上你啊！”
“呵呵，也就一般还行。”
林浩谦虚的笑了笑，心中却很激动，长生仙尊残魂说，五行灵根同境界无敌，果然没有骗他。
光从力气，就能看出。
林浩心中喜悦，脸上却不骄不躁的冲着小胖子笑了笑道：“努力挖矿吧！
咱们今天争取多吃点灵粥。”
content_en:
Chapter 7 Chi Yunzi’s Taoist Heart is Unstable
It was time to work. Lin Hao, who was sitting cross-legged, stopped practicing and got up from the small wooden bed.
"Set a small goal first and reach the ninth level of Qi Refining."
He is full of fighting spirit.
As long as he uses the Five Elements Immortality Technique and reaches the ninth level of Qi Refining, he will have half the life span of a monk at the same level, that is, one hundred and eighty years.
"Boss, have you broken through to the first level of Qi refining?"
The fat boy Wang Fu chatted with Lin Hao and heard Lin Hao mention that he might be able to break through in the next few days.
So early in the morning, he asked with concern.
"Well, a breakthrough has been made."
Lin Hao smiled and replied.
"Boss, you are indeed a talented disciple recruited by Senior Sister Liu. He is indeed amazing."
Wang Fu's fat face showed a look of envy.
"Don't mention that I am a genius disciple in the future. Keep a low profile."
Lin Hao had an unnatural look on his face when he heard the fat man talking about 'Senior Sister Liu'.
His true spiritual root is only the first-grade Five Elements spiritual root. I wonder what little fat Wang Fu's expression will be when he knows the truth.
Will you still be willing to call yourself boss?
The two chatted and walked out of the house side by side, heading to the Spirit Mine.
After receiving the mining tools, Lin Hao and the little fat man entered the mine.
“Qiang Qiang!
DingTalk! "
A large number of handyman disciples were digging, and the sound of chiseling and tapping of stones kept ringing.
"I'm getting stronger!"
Lin Hao waved the pickaxe in his hand and found that after breaking through to the first level of Qi Refining, his strength was at least three times greater than before.
Before the breakthrough, after eating Ban Yue Ling Porridge, he only had close to two hundred kilograms of strength, but now he has at least six hundred kilograms.
With Lin Hao's strength greatly increased, his mining speed skyrocketed.
It only took two hours to dig out spiritual iron that could be exchanged for a meal.
This is still the case when he deliberately hides his clumsiness and uses his spiritual power to mine with all his strength.
It was estimated that in just a little over an hour, he would be able to dig out spiritual iron that could be exchanged for a meal.
"Boss, you are too strong!"
Not far away, the fat boy Wang Fu looked full of admiration and said: "That Yan Heng's cultivation is almost close to the second level of Qi Refining, and his mining speed can't match yours!"
"Haha, it's just average."
Lin Hao smiled modestly, but he was very excited in his heart. The remnant soul of the Immortal Lord of Immortality said that the Five Elements Spiritual Roots were invincible at the same level, and he was indeed not deceived.
You can tell just by looking at the strength.
Lin Hao was happy in his heart, but he smiled at the little fat man without being arrogant or arrogant and said: "Work hard to mine!
Let’s try to eat more spiritual porridge today. "
